name: todocue
description: TodoCue: local task runtime with native macOS and shared Tauri desktop clients, CLI and MCP.

scripts.install:local: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js install
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:release && npm run test:smoke && npm run release:check
scripts.check:macos: npm run check && swift test --package-path apps/macos
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @todocue/desktop
scripts.desktop:check: npm run desktop:build && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
